settings.title: Sniffing tires a dog out faster than walking
settings.text: Fifteen minutes of nose work does more for a restless indoor dog than a thirty-minute march around the block. That is the entire reason a snuffle mat exists.

settings.title: Fast eating is the thing owners notice first
settings.text: If dinner is over in under a minute, the bowl is doing nothing. A maze bowl buys you ten minutes of calm and a dog that settles afterwards.

settings.title: Fur is a maintenance job, not an event
settings.text: Two minutes with a glove, once a day, beats an hour of wrestling once a month. Every grooming tool here is designed to be quick enough that you actually do it.

settings.heading: How long does shipping take?
settings.row_content: Most US orders arrive in 7–15 days. Items ship directly from our supplier partners, which is how we keep prices where they are. You get tracking by email as soon as it is dispatched.

settings.heading: Why is it not 2-day shipping like a big store?
settings.row_content: Because we are not stocking a warehouse. Two-day shipping would mean buying inventory up front and charging you for it. We would rather be honest about a 7–15 day window than promise two days and miss it.

settings.heading: What if my pet doesn't like it?
settings.row_content: Send it back unused within 30 days of delivery and we refund the item price. Full details, including who pays return postage, are in our refund policy.

settings.heading: Are these safe for a puppy or a chewer?
settings.row_content: Nothing here is a chew toy. Snuffle mats and lick mats are feeding tools and should be used supervised, then put away. Swallowed fabric or silicone is a vet visit.

settings.heading: Do you make health claims?
settings.row_content: No. Nothing here treats, cures or prevents anything. These are enrichment and grooming accessories. If your pet has a diagnosed condition, that is a conversation with your vet, not a shopping cart.
